text: The Bank of Russia is the Central Bank of the Russian Federation; its status, goals, functions and powers are defined by the federal law 'On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)'.
short: Bank of Russia is the Russian Federation's central bank

source.name: Bank of Russia (cbr.ru): О Банке России (About the Bank of Russia) — archived copy, snapshot 2025-01-14
source.note: Archived copy of the central bank's official page (Russian). English translation of the quote: 'The status, goals, functions and powers of the Bank of Russia are determined by the federal law of 10.07.2002 No. 86-FZ "On the Central Bank of the Russian Federation (Bank of Russia)"'. The live page (https://www.cbr.ru/about_br/, last updated 16.12.2025) carries the same statement but answers the checker's scripts with 403, so the archived copy is cited.
source.quote: Статус, цели, функции и полномочия Банка России определяются Федеральным законом от 10.07.2002 № 86-ФЗ «О Центральном банке Российской Федерации (Банке России)»

additionalSources.name: NSPK (National Payment Card System): О компании (About NSPK) — live page
additionalSources.note: The NSPK page names the owner as the 'Центральный банк Российской Федерации' (Central Bank of the Russian Federation). Its TLS chain fails Python's verification for our checker (verified with curl); an archived copy is cited on the nspk-owned-by-bank-of-russia claim.
additionalSources.quote: 100% акций АО «НСПК» принадлежит Центральному банку Российской Федерации
